title: EvidenceIssuer
description: Issuer of an authority_verified rung (REV-RES REVW-12). Additive companion to Evidence.schema.json: it supersedes nothing and is intended to be merged as the optional property `issuer` of Evidence at the next contract revision. Server-owned: no client request schema contains it (INV-T04). Present exactly when rung = authority_verified, null otherwise. The UI always shows issuerClass on the badge; matching weights differ by class; instructor-issued attestations require instructor != learner (no shared account or device signal), pass issuer independence checks and are revocable; instructor sign-off is never counted as platform-verified.

issuerId.description: Institution, employer organization or instructor account that issued it; null for platform

issuerLabel.description: Display name shown beside the class
